points.identity_evidence: Southwest Margaree major western tributary follows historical road westward; northern main approaches from northwest, downstream runs southeast past C14. Junction beside road crossing and historical mill.

Ranalds eastern large northern tributary, east of Black Brook and long southern tributaries; northern arm has a fork immediately upstream, main Ranalds approaches from west and bends southeast downstream.

Tompkins Brook outlet through east bank of Northeast Margaree, below elongated river island and above historical mill. Road crosses brook immediately east of bank. Definition is brook centre at river bank, not river centreline. Bank changes remain possible.
